description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - story look: a picture-book co-reading helper for parents - LOOK takes a default-mode photo of the page as a record only (the runtime has no OCR, and the agent sends text only to the language model by design - the platform does support photo input via data: URL image messages, a path this agent does not use - so the glasses never see or read the page), SAY hears the parent describe this page in one sentence (a wearer-mode mic availability check runs first - stream opened, settings read back, stopped - then the host speech recogniser listens on its own microphone; the heard sentence is kept verbatim), TELL sends that description plus the previous pages' descriptions as text only to the host LLM, which returns a warm 2-3 sentence narration for a 3-6 year old and one question to ask the child, falling back to a labelled OFFLINE ECHO (the parent's own words read back as-is plus a rotating built-in bank of 10 gentle questions), READ speaks the narration only when the parent taps it - never automatically, so generated text is previewed on screen before it reaches the child - and NEXT files each page into the last story on device (key storyLook, max 20 pages) for a full READ ALL replay
name: story-look
